title: Role of sediment particle size in cypermethrin toxicity to Chironomus dilutus and Hyalella azteca: insights from bioavailability and exposure pathways
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1988-1997
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00100E, Paper
Hang Su, Jie Zhang, Huizhen Li, Jing You
Variation in sediment particle properties gives rise to diverse settling velocities and distances, leading to distinct distributions of particle sizes in field sediments, while the impact of particle size on sediment toxicity is scarcely known.
